intro: Milos recliner is all about making relaxation natural. We paired a no-fuss push-back design with cream leatherette and resilient foam for simple, soothing comfort.

features.title: We recline without the fuss
features.text: Just lean back—Milos adjusts with your body, no levers or clicks needed. Easy, seamless, intuitive.

features.title: Relief where you carry tension
features.text: The inbuilt lumbar massager targets lower-back strain with 8 vibration modes—because we know where the stress lives.

features.title: We’ve got your back—fully
features.text: From shoulders to spine, the high backrest and head support with soft foam are designed to cradle every part of you.

features.title: Soft care, easy upkeep
features.text: Wrapped in low-maintenance synthetic leather, our recliner is easy to clean, tough to damage, and made to last.

features.title: Built to provide robust support
features.text: With a powder-coated metal frame and quiet, smooth recline, it’s as steady as it is soothing.

features.title: Our armrests follow your natural flow
features.text: The gently rounded shape supports your arms in a relaxed, ergonomic position—offering comfort that feels easy and effortless, whether you’re upright or reclining.

name: Milos 1-Seater Synthetic Leather Manual Recliner Sofa With Massager
